name: T1 Energy Inc. Common Stock
summary: T1 Energy Inc specializes in the creation and distribution of battery cells, catering to diverse sectors including stationary power storage, electric vehicles, and maritime applications. The company operates globally, with a strong presence across Europe. Furthermore, it undertakes the development and construction of manufacturing plants for lithium-ion batteries. T1 Energy Inc was established in 2018 and is headquartered in Luxembourg.
